text:
Alex (Recruiter): Heads-up — new hire Priya K starts Mon 9am PT. Remote, SF payroll, needs I-9, W-4, laptop + badge. :wave:
Marisol (People Ops): Thanks Alex. Do we have her I-9 docs yet? passport on file?
Alex (Recruiter): She uploaded a passport but it's expiring in 2 months — said she's renewing but won't have the new one before start. She can do a staff-assisted I-9 in-person if we arrange a local kiosk, or we can follow the remote exception with coord.
Marisol (People Ops): Ok. If passport expires within 90 days of hire it's still OK for List A, but we need the current passport AND a renewal receipt within 90 days. She won't have renewal receipt by day-1. Can we schedule a 1:1 kiosk at our SF partner for verification? @Badge Courier any availability Mon afternoon?
Badge Courier: I have a 2:30pm slot Mon at the kiosk. Courier can meet outside cafe. ETA for badge prep is 20-30 mins after verification.
Jamie (Eng): FYI she'll need VPN + Jira by 9am for the onboarding call. Can we get laptop shipped earlier?
IT Onboarding Bot: New hire provisioning request created: ticket #HR-1729. ETA for laptop ship: 2 business days. If we need laptop on day-1, local courier/office pickup required.
Alex (Recruiter): Candidate asked if she can pick up laptop from kiosk same day — she's in SF. If courier can drop at kiosk we can do same-day handoff.
Marisol (People Ops): Two items to resolve: 1) I-9 verification plan for expired passport case 2) W-4 not completed (system shows pending). Alex can you nudge candidate to fill W-4 today? We need it for payroll setup.
Alex (Recruiter): DM sent with W-4 link and quick note. She replied, will complete tonight.
Marisol (People Ops): Background check status? I see 'manual review' flagged for alias addresses. That sometimes needs candidate signature on an auth form. Alex, did she sign the consent?
Alex (Recruiter): She signed the standard e-consent but background vendor emailed HR asking for additional address proof — apparently older address mismatch. Candidate said she can provide a utility bill. She's uploading now.
Marisol (People Ops): Cool, please ask candidate to send the vendor verification link to the utility bill upload directly. If the vendor still flags, I'll escalate to Compliance.
Jamie (Eng): If laptop can't arrive by 9am, can we put her on the onboarding call via personal device and schedule access provisioning later? I can make sure non-prod demos are accessible.
Marisol (People Ops): Yes — orientation has low-risk content for day-1. We'll mark required systems for access after confirmation of I-9+W-4. For payroll we need W-4 before first payroll run; if not done, the system defaults to single/no allowances (notify candidate).
Badge Courier: Confirmed kiosk slot 2:30pm Mon. Courier can hand off laptop if IT marks as 'local pickup' by EOD today. IT Onboarding Bot: Updating ticket #HR-1729: requested local pickup label.
Marisol (People Ops): I'll add a note on the day-1 schedule: "Bring current passport + renewal receipt or utility bill for address verification. W-4 must be completed before payroll cutoff." Taking point on escalation if BG vendor rejects.
Alex (Recruiter): Thanks — I'll keep candidate looped. Priya confirmed she'll do the W-4 tonight and upload the utility bill.
Marisol (People Ops): Great. One more: orientation host is scheduled in Zoom (link in calendar). I'll push a short preday checklist to Priya with kiosk details, courier meetup point, and what to expect. :white_check_mark:
Jamie (Eng): Thanks all — I'll prepare a temporary onboarding account if provisioning delays.
Marisol (People Ops): Closing loop: will post here if any vendor escalations. If everyone is good, this should be a smooth hybrid day-1. :smile:
